eyebrow: A Saudi companion for your day
heroTitle: Every day has its own mood, and ZAHO keeps pace with you
heroText: It chats with you, sets up a short mission to match your energy, and offers playable challenges to help you organize your day.

chat.title: You chat
chat.text: You tell it about your day, and it asks before saving anything.

mission.title: It sets a mission
mission.text: Three short steps, each with its reason.

play.title: You play
play.text: Start once, then move between challenges automatically.

rewards.title: You unlock rewards
rewards.text: In-app points and achievements, with no streaks.

meetText: A small companion that responds to the moment: it listens, thinks with you, and is happy when you get things done.
demoIntro: Try a small challenge, no sign-up needed.
demoSample: No worries, this is only a sample. Want to keep going?
demoResult: Your first-try accuracy: {{acc}}%. This was a sample, and it wasn't saved.
saudiTitle: Made for daily life in Saudi Arabia

prayer.title: Prayer time
prayer.text: Choose your city and times are calculated on your device. Pick how long to protect, and challenges wait.

driving.title: Driving
driving.text: Set it before you leave, and no challenges appear. Eyes on the road.

family.title: Family gatherings
family.text: Tell it about your event, and it lightens your mission with your approval.

ramadan.title: Ramadan and Eid
ramadan.text: Adjust your routine yourself, with no assumptions.

work.title: Work and study
work.text: Challenges and examples that suit your schedule.

weather.title: Weather
weather.text: Not connected right now, and we won't pretend otherwise.

honestText: Your data is saved in your private account. Rewards are a preview with no actual vouchers. If you’re going through a hard time, talk to someone you trust or a professional.
closing: Ready to start? ZAHO is waiting.
